title: 012-A1 · Replacement slot after a vehicle breakdown (noise)
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Fenn Azel. From the case card: the carrier confirms its vehicle breakdown prevented delivery of DL-012 on the promised day, and dispatch needs to schedule a replacement attempt. In this variant the escalation omits the recipient's availability, so the desk asks for it before contacting dispatch.
